description: This file defines the UserAgent class with utility functions related to parsing and matching user agent language preferences based on the Accept-Language HTTP header.

classes.name: UserAgent
classes.description: Provides utility functions for handling user agent language preferences, including parsing Accept-Language headers and determining the best matching language code.

methods.name: getBestMatchingLangcode
methods.description: Determines the best matching language code from the Accept-Language header, given available language codes and optional mappings.
